scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev --package-lock=true && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev --package-lock=true
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev --package-lock=true && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev --package-lock=true
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start: bash -lc 'npm --prefix backend start & npm --prefix frontend start & wait'
scripts.dev: bash -lc 'npm --prefix backend run dev & npm --prefix frontend run dev & wait'
